summary: China stagflation traps A-shares with Tech extended and deep value oversold; HK rides China risk-off via a weak peg despite benign US backdrop — mean-reversion thesis intact but lacking domestic catalyst.
regime_read: A-shares sit in stagflation (growth –0.07, inflation 0.91) with PBoC neutral, creating tension: Technology’s +16% 20d (+41% 60d, 75th %ile) dominates, yet the cycle and mean-reversion argue it is extremely extended. Deeply oversold sectors — Banks (0.4 %ile, –11.8% 60d), Healthcare (0.8 %ile, –16.6% 60d), Consumer Staples (0.4 %ile, –25% 60d) — offer higher-odds setups but lack a policy catalyst. USD/CNY firming modestly (–0.64% 20d) is a marginal tailwind, not yet a game-changer. Hong Kong’s Reflation label is deceptive: the global risk score is neutral, but the HKD peg is on the weak side (outflow) and the primary driver is ‘China risk-off spillover.’ Financials & Banks have run to a 99.6% pctile — extreme strength in a market under capital-flight stress — while Internet/Tech sits mid-range. The US macro Goldilocks with contracting liquidity and restrictive real yields (2.23%) provides no tailwind, and bonds (stock-bond correlation broken) offer no hedge. Oversold A-share value is the high-convexity setup, but only a domestic liquidity shift unlocks it.
conflicts: Stagflation + Tech extreme RS: The sector’s 41% 60d surge contradicts the stagflation narrative (likely AI-driven); mean-reversion says it is due for a reversal, but no catalyst visible yet.

PBoC neutral liquidity vs. deep oversold value: Without easing, mean-reversion in Banks (0.4%ile), Healthcare (0.8%ile) or Consumer Staples (0.4%ile) may stall — the domestic policy heartbeat is absent.
HK Financials & Banks extreme RS (99.6%ile) while peg weak-side outflows intensify: typically capital flight hurts financials; this divergence looks fragile.
Global reflation FX regime (favouring commodity FX/EM) vs. US Goldilocks with contracting liquidity: the EM equity pocket (EEM) faces a dollar headwind, mixing signals for HK’s reflation story.
Inflation basket ratio down –8.2% in China despite high inflation score: suggests disinflationary pressure in sector prices, conflicting with the stagflation tag’s implication for commodities.
rotation_check: The thesis that A-shares mean-revert and RS leaders are extended is fully corroborated: Technology is a classic overbought extreme while Banks, Healthcare, and Consumer Staples are historically crushed. However, the absence of a PBoC liquidity pivot means the rotation trigger is missing. Hong Kong’s divergence — local RS strength despite China risk-off and peg outflows — aligns with the thesis that HK rides global risk and the dollar, but the extreme RS in Financials and the weak peg argue the mean-reversion risk in HK is also elevated.
transmission: A PBoC shift from neutral to accommodative would ignite deep oversold mean-reversion in Banks, Real Estate, Consumer — the chain starts with liquidity and flows into credit impulse.
Further USD/CNY appreciation (break below 6.70) eases capital-flight fears and supports A-shares, especially import-linked consumption names; no domestic policy needed.
HK peg pressure: USD/HKD testing 7.85 forces HKMA intervention expectations, lifts HIBOR, and hits rate-sensitive property and financials, correcting the extreme RS.

Persistent US real yield elevation (2.23%) + hawkish Fed repricing keeps a lid on HK tech duration and gold, even as the commodity regime favours gold and copper — a tension that may cap resource plays.

The commodity Goldilocks regime and copper’s safe-haven status could stabilise A-share Nonferrous Metals (rank 2, RS 63th %ile, not extreme) — a relative-value mean-reversion candidate if global reflation persists.
watch_items: China PBoC liquidity overlay shift (currently neutral) — the single most important domestic catalyst.
USD/CNY break below 6.70 confirming sustained CNH strength.
HKMA intervention or HKD peg breach (USD/HKD approaching 7.85).
Technology RS 20d momentum turn — a pullback through 8–10% would trigger mean-reversion entry.
US 10y real yield above 2.3% — headwind for HK and EM duration plays.
Southbound flow reversal to net selling accelerates — would deepen HK sell-off.
Next CPI/PPI prints in China: a drop in inflation score would flip the quad toward ‘Deflation’ and change the sector map.

conflicts: 全球再通胀外汇机制（利好商品货币/新兴市场）vs 美国金发姑娘环境与流动性收缩：新兴市场股票板块（EEM）面临美元逆风，为香港再通胀故事带来复杂信号。
中国通胀篮子比率下降8.2%，尽管通胀评分高企：表明行业价格面临通缩压力，与滞胀标签对商品的含义相矛盾。
transmission: 中国央行从中性转向宽松将点燃银行、房地产、消费板块的深度超卖均值回归——链条从流动性开始，流入信用脉冲。
美元/人民币进一步升值（跌破6.70）缓解资本外逃担忧，支撑A股，尤其是进口相关消费股；无需国内政策干预。
港元联系汇率压力：美元/港元测试7.85迫使市场预期香港金管局干预，推升HIBOR，打击利率敏感的房地产和金融板块，修正极端相对强弱。
美国实际收益率持续高企（2.23%）+ 美联储鹰派重定价压制香港科技板块久期和黄金，尽管商品机制利好黄金和铜——这一紧张局势可能限制资源股表现。
大宗商品的金发女孩经济体制和铜的避险地位可能稳定A股有色金属（排名第2，相对强弱位于第63百分位，不极端）——若全球再通胀持续，这是一个相对价值均值回归候选。
watch_items: 中国央行流动性叠加调整（目前中性）——最重要的国内催化剂。
美元/人民币跌破6.70，确认离岸人民币持续走强。
香港金管局干预或港元联系汇率破位（美元/港元接近7.85）。
科技板块相对强弱20日动量转向——回调8-10%将触发均值回归入场。
美国10年期实际收益率高于2.3%——对香港和新兴市场久期交易构成阻力。
南向资金转为净流出加速——这将加剧港股抛售。
中国下一次CPI/PPI数据发布：通胀得分下降将使象限转向‘通缩’并改变行业格局。
